featured_title: Moving to Naples, FL: The 2026 Complete School Attendance Zone Guide for Families
featured_excerpt: Collier County Public Schools assigns students by geographic attendance boundary tied to the home address. But the district evaluates every attendance area annually, and in December 2025 the School Board rezoned part of the Estates Elementary area to a school that had not opened yet.
